risk_report.rationale: The incident report indicates a patient experienced life-threatening complete atrioventricular block following an unflagged ventricular fibrillation episode, requiring emergency resuscitation and confirmed by hospital records. This event may trigger obligations under EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2) for post-market surveillance system planning and implementation. The regulatory context emphasizes the importance of IT security (MDR-annexI-sec17.4-it-security), software development lifecycle and cybersecurity (MDR-annexI-sec17.2-software-lifecycle), and device labeling and packaging controls (QMSR-820.45-labeling). The static analysis reports for unrelated firmware modules do not provide relevant information to support the severity assessment. Given the potential impact on patient safety, a CAPA investigation is recommended.
